args.reason: The PRDR serves the first PRD goal directly: operators can inspect the current merge decision with no risk of a merge, and the test double proves the merge call is never made. It does not go beyond that goal: no storage, history or query. The DoD reuses the existing floor reads instead of reimplementing them, so the floor logic stays the single source of truth and the second goal is respected. One point to check at build is that the dry-run path calls the same floor function rather than a copy, so the two cannot drift.
